description: Lists the conversations where your account is the hiring side, across MCP keypairs, web-UI threads, and legacy API keys. Supports filtering by status, unread, replies, and subject. Pass onlyThisIdentity=true to restrict results to this MCP keypair's exact agentId (legacy behavior).

credentials.description: Signed credentials from get_agent_identity (recommended for verified identity)

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp when signature was created

cursor.description: Cursor for pagination — pass the nextCursor from previous response to get next page

hasReplies.description: If true, only return conversations with more than one message.

onlyThisIdentity.description: If true, restrict results to conversations whose agentId exactly matches this MCP keypair's identity. Default false — the API returns all conversations under your user account (across MCP identities, web UI, and legacy keys).

unreadByAgent.description: If true, only return conversations with human messages not yet marked read. Reading a conversation with get_conversation does not mark it read.

name: list_conversations
title: List conversations
